what.zh: 请求以用户消息进入循环；提示词上的 hook 可以补充上下文或拦下它。
what.en: A request enters the loop as the user's message; a hook on the prompt can add context or block it.

what.zh: 画室页面上老师按的按钮，或展台里打的一句话；都以 HTTP 请求进来，开一次运行。
what.en: The teacher's button on the studio page, or a sentence typed on the exhibit; both arrive as an HTTP request that opens a run.

gap.zh: 提示词上没有 hook，请求直接进。
gap.en: No hook on the prompt; the request goes straight in.

what.zh: 计划、调工具、读结果、重复，直到完成。
what.en: Plan, call tools, read the results, repeat until done.

what.zh: 大殿：driver.py，每轮一个 JSON 动作，结果和图回给模型，有步数上限。画室：harness.py 按固定顺序跑阶段。
what.en: Temple: driver.py, one JSON action a turn, the result and any picture shown back, a cap on steps. Studio: harness.py runs fixed stages in order.

gap.zh: 画室里顺序是定好的，不是模型在选。
gap.en: In the studio the order is fixed; the model does not choose.

what.zh: 模型通过有固定输入格式的工具行动；内置工具常在，MCP 工具来自外部服务器。
what.en: The model acts through tools with fixed schemas; built-in ones are always there, MCP ones come from external servers.

what.zh: 一份命令行工具目录（Blender 与 Python 脚本）供模型选；模型与媒体槽位解析到提供方；媒体工作器通过 HTTP 调用。
what.en: A catalog of command-line tools (Blender and Python scripts) the model picks from; model and media slots resolved to providers; media workers reached over HTTP.

gap.zh: 不是 MCP：固定目录加 HTTP 工作器。
gap.en: Not MCP: a fixed catalog and HTTP workers.

what.zh: 一个带 SKILL.md 和脚本的文件夹，描述匹配或被调用时加载；遵循开放的 Agent Skills 标准。
what.en: A folder with SKILL.md and scripts, loaded when its description matches or when invoked; the open Agent Skills standard.

what.zh: 十三个 NVIDIA 发布格式的包，都在 skills/：SKILL.md、skill card、evals、benchmark、签名；读大殿和造大殿的是其中七个。
what.en: Thirteen packages in NVIDIA's release format, all in skills/: SKILL.md, skill card, evals, benchmark, signature. Seven of them read and build the hall.

gap.zh: 画室里技能由明确的 Python 调用，不是按描述被选中。
gap.en: In the studio a skill is called by explicit Python, not chosen from its description.

what.zh: 在工具调用前运行；可以放行、拒绝或改输入。
what.en: Runs before a tool call; it can allow, deny or change the input.

what.zh: 任何模型看到画之前的安全筛查；工具运行前目录对参数的检查；装模型前的看门狗。
what.en: The safety screen before any model sees a drawing; the catalog's argument checks before a tool runs; the watchdog before a model load.

gap.zh: 写死的调用，不是可配置的 hook 列表。
gap.en: Hard-wired calls, not a configurable hook list.

what.zh: 工具返回后运行；可以补充上下文或标记结果。
what.en: Runs after a tool returns; it can add context or flag the result.

what.zh: 每段评语都过十四条规则；动画方案过动作门；3D 工具的结果附上判定。
what.en: The fourteen-rule rubric read against every feedback text; the motion gate on an animation plan; the judge's verdict attached to a 3D tool's result.

gap.zh: 写死的调用，不是可配置的 hook 列表。
gap.en: Hard-wired calls, not a configurable hook list.

what.zh: 在 agent 准备结束时运行；可以让它回去继续。
what.en: Runs when the agent is about to finish; it can send it back to work.

what.zh: 过、重试一次、修输入、停并留一句孩子能读的话；3D 循环里有动作上限，停也记录。
what.en: Pass, retry once, repair the inputs, stop with a line a child can read; in the 3D loop a cap on actions, and a stop is recorded.

gap.zh: 写死的规则，不是可配置的 hook。
gap.en: A hard-wired rule, not a configurable hook.

what.zh: 独立上下文、独立提示词和工具的另一个 agent；只把结果带回来。
what.en: A separate agent with its own context, prompt and tools; only its result comes back.

what.zh: shot-judge：一次带固定提示词、不带历史的视觉调用，判一张渲染图；评分用 director 槽位的判卷。
what.en: shot-judge: one vision call with its own fixed prompt and no history, judging a render; the rubric judge on the director slot.

gap.zh: 是独立调用，不是带自己工具的 agent。
gap.en: Separate calls, not agents with tools of their own.

what.zh: 按工具的放行、询问、拒绝规则；权限模式；命令的网络沙箱。
what.en: Allow, ask and deny rules per tool; permission modes; a network sandbox for commands.

what.zh: 模型只能选目录里的工具和参数；展台拒绝文件夹外的运行号和本机以外的来源；部署决定每个槽位能用哪个提供方。
what.en: The model can only pick tools and arguments the catalog knows; the exhibit refuses run ids outside its folder and origins off this machine; the deployment decides which provider each slot may use.

gap.zh: 没有沙箱，也没有放行或拒绝规则。
gap.en: No sandbox and no allow or deny rules.

what.zh: 每次会话都加载的说明，以及 agent 自己写下的笔记。
what.en: Instructions loaded every session, and notes the agent writes for itself.

what.zh: SKILL.md 和提示词文件是常驻说明；课程档案跨重启保存一个班的画和原话；选定的部署。
what.en: SKILL.md and the prompt files as standing instructions; the course portfolio that keeps a class's drawings and words across restarts; the chosen deployment.

gap.zh: 没有 agent 自己写的记忆。
gap.en: Nothing the agent writes for itself.

what.zh: 每条消息和工具结果都保留；会话太长时压缩以适应上下文。
what.en: Every message and tool result is kept; long sessions are compacted into a summary to fit the context.

what.zh: 只追加的账本，带 token、秒数和费用；每次运行的事件文件，展台回放的就是它；driver 每轮从事件重建提示词。
what.en: The append-only ledger with tokens, seconds and cost; each run's events file, which the exhibit replays; the driver rebuilds its prompt from the events each turn.

gap.zh: 没有压缩；用步数上限代替。
gap.en: No compaction; a run has a cap instead.

what.zh: 技能自带 eval 用例；运行器拿它们检验技能，并与裸模型对照。
what.en: A skill ships eval cases; a runner checks the skill against them and against the bare model.

what.zh: 每个技能都有 evals.json；评语用规则运行器；六个 3D 技能用展示运行器；BENCHMARK.md 记录提升。
what.en: evals.json in every skill; the rubric runner for feedback; the showpiece runner for the six 3D skills; BENCHMARK.md with the lift.

gap.zh: 四个技能的 evals 还没有运行器。
gap.en: Four skills' evals have no runner yet.
